notes.title: Difficulty & Mutants Update
notes.notes:
Difficulty & Mutants Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41453633/53e966d381f8a5bd957c0406f729e90a88f5fc91.png


Difficulty System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41453633/26e2bea8093f82eaf107094997ba1eef8058de29.png

Select the level of difficulty of your game.
The higher it is, the faster and more powerful your enemies will be. 
But you too, Soldier, you will be stronger.

Beginner
The default difficulty.
It's perfect to train your mechanics and kick asses.

Average
Slightly increased difficulty.
You will start to sweat. It's your turn to get your ass kicked.
Enemies are faster and more resistant and Mutants are more numerous.

Exerpt
The hard mode of Project Umbra. Intented for aggressive players.
From now on, stop laughing. Get ready to spit blood.
Enemies are significantly faster and resistant. Mutants are legio. And a new enemy has appeared.


Mutants
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41453633/41365335cd7ccb40e8d2f7d540761aa10d8c8d7e.png

Mutants are enemies who have absorbed a greater amount of Shadow energy.
Their power is increased tenfold as well as their resistance.
Be careful because it will not be easy to destroy them.

But killing them will bring you a huge amount of score.

----------------------------------------

The Project Umbra team hope you enjoy this new content.

Now is the time to go and explode somes mutants!
